headline: General Motors Aims to Cut Vehicle Design Timelines to Two Years Using AI
summary: General Motors is implementing artificial intelligence tools to shorten new vehicle design timelines to as little as two years, seeking to compete more effectively with rapid Chinese automakers.
why: Automakers face intense competitive and pricing pressure from Chinese electric vehicle makers operating with faster product development cycles.

impacts.name: General Motors Company
impacts.why: Shortening the vehicle design cycle could reduce capital expenditures and accelerate time-to-market against foreign competitors.
